endpoints.purpose: Authenticate a user and return a bearer token plus basket id
validationRules: No validation of any kind on email or password
email is concatenated directly into raw SQL: SELECT * FROM Users WHERE email = '${req.body.email || ''}'
password is hashed before concatenation, so it is not an injection point
401 with body status 'totp_token_required' when the matched user has a totpSecret
401 with text 'Invalid email or password.' when no user matches
handler errors are passed to next(), producing a 500

endpoints.purpose: Search products by name or description
validationRules: query param q is optional; the literal string 'undefined' is treated as empty
q is truncated to the first 200 characters
q is concatenated into raw SQL: SELECT * FROM Products WHERE name LIKE '%${criteria}%' OR description LIKE '%${criteria}%'
no escaping, no parameterisation, no type check
errors are passed to next(), producing a 500

endpoints.purpose: Return the running application configuration to the client
Issue a captcha challenge used by the contact form

validationRules: four separate handlers are registered on this same path in server.ts (lines 427, 439, 440, 441)
verify.passwordRepeatChallenge and verify.emptyUserRegistration are registered as middleware on it

endpoints.purpose: List the 116 documented challenges and their solved state

notes: server.ts registers 102 distinct method+path routes. I read the handlers for 10 of them and listed only those.
The 92 routes not listed here were not read, so this surface is deliberately partial. Coverage numbers below are against the 10 read, not against the whole app.
requiredFields and statusCodes for POST /api/Users are incomplete: four handlers share that path and I read only the registration lines, not each handler body.
statusCodes for the sequelize auto-generated REST routes (/api/*) were not read from source; only 200 is listed because that is what the crawl observed.
No auth guard was seen on any of the 10 routes read. That is what the source shows, not an assumption that the app has no auth anywhere.
